drivingQuestion: When the Jubilee arrives and a consecrated ancestral field has not been redeemed, do the priests enter into it, and must they give its redemption payment to the Temple treasury?
outcomeNote: The mishna records three tannaitic positions side by side without deciding between them.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הִגִּיעַ יוֹבֵל וְלֹא נִגְאֲלָה, הַכֹּהֲנִים נִכְנָסִין לְתוֹכָהּ וְנוֹתְנִין אֶת דָּמֶיהָ, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: נִכְנָסִין וְלֹא נוֹתְנִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one consecrated his ancestral field and the «Jubilee» Year «arrived and it was not redeemed» by the owner or anyone else, «the priests enter into» the field «and give its» redemption «payment» to the Temple treasury; this is «the statement of Rabbi Yehuda. Rabbi Shimon says: They enter» into the field, «but they do not give» its redemption payment to the Temple treasury.

segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: לֹא נִכְנָסִין וְלֹא נוֹתְנִין, אֶלָּא נִקְרֵאת ״שְׂדֵה רְטוּשִׁין״ עַד הַיּוֹבֵל הַשֵּׁנִי. הִגִּיעַ הַיּוֹבֵל הַשֵּׁנִי וְלֹא נִגְאֲלָה, נִקְרֵאת ״רְטוּשֵׁי רְטוּשִׁין״ עַד הַיּוֹבֵל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי. לְעוֹלָם אֵין הַכֹּהֲנִים נִכְנָסִין לְתוֹכָהּ עַד שֶׁיִּגְאָלֶנָּה אַחֵר.
segments.en: «Rabbi Eliezer says:» The priests «do not enter» into the field, «and» they also «do not give» its redemption payment to the Temple treasury. «Rather,» the field remains in the possession of the Temple treasury, and «it is called: An abandoned field, until the second Jubilee» Year. If «the second Jubilee arrived and it was» still «not redeemed, it is called: An abandoned» field from among the «abandoned» fields, meaning one that was abandoned twice, «until the third Jubilee.» In any case, «the priests never enter into» a consecrated field during the Jubilee Year «until another» person «redeems it» first.

moves.summary: The mishna rules that at the Jubilee the priests enter the unredeemed consecrated field and pay its value, and tags this as R׳ Yehuda's statement.
moves.about: the mishna names R׳ Yehuda as the holder of the ruling that the priests enter the unredeemed consecrated field at the Jubilee and pay its redemption value

moves.summary: R׳ Shimon holds that the priests enter but do not pay.
moves.about: whether the priests who take possession of an unredeemed consecrated ancestral field at the Jubilee must pay its redemption value to the Temple treasury

moves.summary: R׳ Eliezer holds that the priests neither enter nor pay; the field is called שדה רטושין until the second Jubilee, and רטושי רטושין until the third.
moves.about: whether the priests take possession of an unredeemed consecrated ancestral field at the Jubilee at all, and whether they pay its value

moves.summary: The general rule of his view: the priests never enter until someone else redeems the field first.
moves.about: whether the priests enter the unredeemed consecrated field at the Jubilee before another person has redeemed it from the Temple treasury

edges.about: the mishna names R׳ Yehuda as the holder of the ruling that the priests enter the unredeemed consecrated field at the Jubilee and pay its redemption value
